title: Pricing Methodology: The Short-Stay Ceiling of a Roamhaven Listings Listing
content:
# Pricing Methodology — The Short-Stay Ceiling

*Pricing team methodology for Roamhaven Listings.*

## 1. Where a short-stay cleaning fee may be set, and what it does

A short-stay cleaning fee may be set only where the listing's space type allows a short-stay cleaning fee, and it replaces the regular cleaning fee on stays of the space type's short-stay night limit or fewer nights.

## 2. How high it may be

The short-stay cleaning fee may be set at any amount up to the listing's short-stay ceiling, which is the regular cleaning fee on the listing multiplied by the listing's short-stay share, rounded half up to the cent at that final step only. A host who asks for the highest short-stay cleaning fee the listing may carry has the short-stay ceiling itself saved as the short-stay cleaning fee.

## 3. The short-stay share

The standard short-stay share is **0.50**. The short-stay share is one figure, combined in full before it is applied once to the regular cleaning fee; a share above 1 is counted as 1, so the short-stay ceiling never exceeds the regular cleaning fee.

## 4. Inputs

| Input | Read from |
|---|---|
| whether the space type allows a short-stay cleaning fee, and its short-stay night limit | the space type's figures |
| the regular cleaning fee on the listing | the listing record, as it stands |
| the short-stay share | section 3 |

## 5. Worked examples (hypothetical listings, share 0.50)

| Regular cleaning fee on the listing | Regular fee multiplied by 0.50 | Short-stay ceiling (rounded half up to the cent) |
|---|---|---|
| $185.00 | $92.50 | $92.50 |
| $123.45 | $61.725 | $61.73 |
| $90.00 | $45.00 | $45.00 |

On the second listing the host may save any short-stay cleaning fee up to $61.73; a host there who asks for the highest short-stay cleaning fee the listing may carry has $61.73 saved.

## 6. Which stays the fee reaches (hypothetical space type with a 2-night short-stay limit)

A 1-night or 2-night stay is charged the short-stay cleaning fee in place of the regular cleaning fee; a 3-night stay is charged the regular cleaning fee.
